## What I propose

For one observation and separately identified array bundles, start with an
unseeded ordinary PTC→MAP bootstrap. Each later iteration reruns the original
measured parent and uses the preceding complete, supported MAP product as its
feedback model. Accept every model value on the declared bootstrap science
support, including either sign; use no brightness, S/N or RMS selector.
Propose matched containing-pixel removal and rejoin, and hold the bootstrap
PTC operator and map-contribution population fixed across feedback iterations.

I also propose an explicitly PTC-owned uniform unit analysis/gridding family,
retained from bootstrap with new compatibility/QC records at each application.
That is a new proposal, not an inferred default or precision weight. None of
these method choices is approved by the scope decision. The method deliberately
protects noise structure as well as sources; it is a transparent first definition,
not a demonstrated improvement or a production policy.

The [method definition](METHOD_DEFINITION.md) gives concrete rules, bootstrap,
finite extent and all twenty-one method-record dispositions. The
[two-sided boundary table](PTC_MAP_BOUNDARIES.md) identifies each producer and
consumer, quantity/reference/support/occurrence identity and missing authority.
The [historical comparison](HISTORICAL_COMPARISON.md) keeps the JINC control
separate. [U01–U08 and remaining questions](DISPOSITIONS_AND_OWNER_QUESTIONS.md)
state exactly what is resolved, proposed or blocked.

## Current route disposition

`unavailable_under_current_frozen_parent_permissions`.

Frozen PTC's primary-input/ordinary-fit contract and frozen MAP's PTC-output
input contract do not establish the two proposed residual/rejoined product
permissions. This packet proposes the precise bounded interfaces that would
be needed; it does not adopt them or relabel descendants. The missing PTC
coefficient family and exact MAP numerical support policy are additional gates.
If the owner does not authorize those controlled successors, this candidate
route remains unavailable. No wider route or replacement estimator is substituted.

The next owner review is concrete method rules and the named boundary actions,
not scope renewal. The numerical PTC plan, support scalar and execution bindings
are explicit later prerequisites. No experiment design or execution is included.
